__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Your Grafana Cloud Prometheus data source

panels.title: Host CPU busy & swap used (%) by node
Retrieval recall@5 (live, 7d)
panels.description: Share of executed or confirmed commands that were among the examples retrieval handed the LLM. Labelled by the command that ran, so it measures agreement with the LLM.

panels.title: Retrieval recall@5 (eval)
panels.description: Recall@5 over the held-out eval dataset, pushed by the prompt-eval workflow (weekly and on prompt PRs).

panels.title: LLM tokens (24h)
panels.description: Provider-reported tokens the agent spent across all chats. Sizes AGENT_TOKENS_PER_DAY_*.

panels.title: Budget rejections (24h)
panels.description: LLM calls over a token budget, dry run included (agent_budget_enforced=false counts the calls it would have refused).

panels.title: Commands by name, platform and chat (command.run)
Latency percentiles by command (time range)
panels.description: Percentiles over the whole dashboard range: at a few dozen commands a day a 5m rate is mostly empty. The top bucket is 120s, so a p99 of 120000 means at least that.

targets.expr: (sum by (command_name) (increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{span_name="command.run", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__range])) or sum by (command_name) (increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{span_name="command.run"}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (command_name) (increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{span_name="command.run"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Command runs by platform and chat type
Self time vs total (where the wait is)
Total vs self time by span (time range)
panels.description: Total is the span's whole duration. Self is that minus the union of its awaited children, so a parent waiting on a slow call shows a big total and a small self, and the slow call shows the self. Sum of self times never counts a wait twice.

panels.title: Self time by work kind (io / cpu / fire_and_forget)
Upstream hosts (time range)
panels.description: Every outbound httpx call by host. Errors are client spans with an error status (4xx, 5xx, transport failures). Telegram's long-poll getUpdates dominates the call count.

targets.expr: (sum by (server_address) (increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT", server_address!="", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__range])) or sum by (server_address) (increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT", server_address!=""}[$__range])) * 0) / sum by (server_address) (increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT", server_address!=""}[$__range]))

panels.title: Caught upstream failures by upstream
panels.description: upstream.failures: one per upstream_failed log, the failures a command caught and answered around (fallbacks included).

panels.title: Event loop lag (p50 / p99)
panels.description: How late the loop woke a 1s sleeper. CPU work left on the event loop shows here, and it delays every other command and heartbeat by the same amount.

panels.title: Deliveries in flight (prefetch 4)
panels.description: Commands being processed at once. Pinned at 4 means the consumer is saturated and the queue grows.

panels.title: ,dl lane wait (p50 / p95, 1h)
panels.description: Time an exclusive command waited for the lane another one held.

panels.title: Dead-letter queue depth
panels.description: Commands parked after the retry ladder, kept 7 days. Replay with uv run task dlq:replay.

panels.title: SLOs (30 days, command.run on every platform)
Availability (SLO 95%)
panels.description: Share of command runs without an external or unexpected failure. bot_error (the user's mistake) counts as good.

panels.title: Availability budget left
panels.description: Share of the 5% error budget still unspent this 30 days.

panels.title: Under 10s (SLO 90%, no ,dl)
panels.description: Share of command runs other than ,dl that finished in under 10s.

panels.title: Latency budget left
panels.description: Share of the 10% latency budget still unspent this 30 days.

panels.title: Availability burn rate (1h / 6h)
panels.description: 1 burns the budget exactly in 30 days. The fast alert fires above 14.4 on 1h, the slow one above 6 on 6h.

panels.title: Latency burn rate (1h / 6h)
panels.description: The fast alert fires above 6 on 1h, the slow one above 3 on 6h.

panels.title: Command flow (time range)
panels.description: Where commands end up. Delivered only counts WhatsApp (the broker path); ran counts every platform. User error is a bot_error: a bad argument or a group-only command in a DM.

panels.title: Agent state outcomes (time range)
panels.description: Where the natural-language agent's state machine ended each mapping.

panels.title: Gate refusals by reason (time range)
panels.description: Disabled, dev only, switched off in the chat, or an NSFW command outside a Discord NSFW channel.

panels.title: Minors filter drops by source (time range)
panels.description: Items an NSFW feed returned that the denylist refused to send. Best effort: a rising count means a feed is pushing more of it, not that the filter is complete.

panels.title: Top commands (time range)
panels.description: The ten most run commands across every platform.
